note: reach/stamped/lookupable/observedAt/run: the HIGH-WATER MARK of what one completed refresh-newegg-prices run leaves behind (the share of re-pricer-reachable deals.newegg rows carrying refreshedAt). It only ever moves up. sftp-ingest.cjs derives the census stamp-plausibility floor from it (floor = reach / 2). last/history: EVERY full run, including the ones below the mark, so a drop in reach is on record; nothing derives a floor from them. Do not hand-edit: a lowered mark relaxes the census gate.
